intro: Burundi is a small, hilly country on Lake Tanganyika with a long royal history and a painful recent past.

chapters.title: Kingdom of Burundi
text: A kingdom ruled by a mwami (king) existed from the 1600s. Royal drummers played sacred drums, a tradition that survives today.

chapters.title: German and Belgian rule
text: Germany claimed Burundi in the 1890s, and Belgium ruled it with Rwanda after World War One. It became independent in 1962 as a monarchy, then a republic in 1966.

chapters.title: Conflict and peace
text: Violence between Hutu and Tutsi groups killed many in 1972 and in a civil war from 1993 to 2005. The Arusha peace agreement helped end the war. A 2015 crisis over a third presidential term led to deadly unrest.
